notes.drift_note: b(x) is read directly from drift_function_grid.csv for the selected model.
notes.diffusion_note: D_raw_interp is the selected empirical diffusion proxy interpolated onto xgrid; D_smooth is after Gaussian smoothing; D_final is after applying D_floor. All FP diagnostics use D_final.
notes.empirical_density_note: p_emp is built from trajectories_long.csv and may be restricted to observable==True if --traj_observable_only is used.
notes.diagnostic_note: J and S are empirical diagnostics relative to p_emp and the inferred b(x), D(x); they quantify departures from the closed stationary density.
